notes.title: Steal, Then Just Escape: The Real Thrill has ReTurn to Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Dear Real Thrillers,

       Steal, Then Just Escape: The Real Thrill has ReTurn to Coming Soon! After postponing the ReLaunch in February. I would like you to know that the game will be back on Coming Soon! Stage. You can’t currently play it on Steam or Epic Games Store, but you can still buy it. Opening the game, you would just see a UI saying, Coming Soon! And a suggestion box and please share your game ideas. Now, this is Real Thrill, escaping for a few months. But I shall ReLaunch.

Yours !RTS CEO,
Rav Martin Maniti

notes.title: Steal, Then Just Escape is back in 'Early Access.'
notes.notes:
Expect major bugs, but you can still Steal, Then Just Escape.
Steal, Then Just Escape is back in 'Early Access,' thrilling up for version 2.0, also known as Steal, Then Just Escape: The Real Thrill.
!RTS can guarantee that version 2.0 will be free of bugs.

This major game update includes: 
	Cloud-Based Login and Sign-Up
	Improved Gun Aiming Mechanics
	Enhanced Sound Effects, Lighting Effects, and Graphics
	Customizable Key Configuration
	Colorblind Accessibility Feature
	New Statistics System
	Interactive Character Voice Lines
	Subtitles for Accessibility and Story Immersion
	Switchable First-Person and Third-Person Perspectives
	Escaping Score System for Competitive Play
	Comprehensive Storytelling Experience

The relaunch is scheduled for both Epic Games Store and Steam on February 17th.

notes.title: Control the Special Thrill.
notes.notes:
Control the Special Thrill.

You can now use XBOX controllers to Steal, Then Just Escape. Go to "Key Bindings" to see the controller configurations.

Each level is hovered by only seven monsters, but these are no ordinary creatures. Each monster is immensely strong, equipped with powerful attacks, and bigger than they should be.

New Weapons are added to each characters.

You can choose from three characters, each bringing their unique abilities to the game.

Rafael have Ak-47, AR4, Lucio have Ak-47, KAVal, K47U, and AR4 for Janelle all have pistol.

Each acount is limited to one particular character.

To activate Speedrun Mode, navigate to the options menu and select the checkbox labeled "Speedrun." Once enabled, your current time will be displayed during gameplay,

notes.title: Sign Up for Steal, Then Just Escape and Log In to Experience the Real Thrill!.
notes.notes: With this new update, you can save your stats directly to [b]your own account[/b]. When you sign in, your previous games [b]will automatically be added to your profile[/b]. In the settings, you can change both your [b]username and password[/b], or even delete your account if you wish. [b]No personal information is required[/b]—just create a gamer username to Experience the Real Thrill!
